source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    active_rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v != bg for v in row)]
    groups = []
    for r in active_rows:
        if not groups or r > groups[-1][-1] + 1:
            groups.append([r])
        else:
            groups[-1].append(r)
    if len(groups) < 2:
        return out
    a, b = groups[0], groups[1]
    for ra, rb in zip(a, b):
        xa = max((c for c, v in enumerate(grid[ra]) if v != bg), default=-1)
        xb = max((c for c, v in enumerate(grid[rb]) if v != bg), default=-1)
        if xa < 0 or xb < 0 or abs(xa - xb) <= 1:
            continue
        short_r, long_end = (ra, xb) if xa < xb else (rb, xa)
        short_end = max(c for c, v in enumerate(grid[short_r]) if v != bg)
        for c in range(short_end + 1, long_end + 1):
            if out[short_r][c] == bg:
                out[short_r][c] = 1
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
